title: Disposal of Unserviceable Computer, Printer and UPS under the Cochin Directorate
summary: Sealed-bid auction, on an as-is-where-is basis, of unserviceable all-in-one computers, printers, UPS units and old printer cartridges of the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin, open only to authorised e-waste producers, refurbishers and recyclers.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, Gandhi Nagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin - 682020

scope.item: Dell OptiPlex 7440 AIO Desktop with accessories
Old unserviceable LaserJet printer cartridges (to be taken by highest bidder without extra payment)

money.notes: Reserve price for items 1-3 Rs 12,500. EMD 25% of quoted price by DD in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Cochin, valid 3 months; balance 75% within 7 days of order. Taxes/duties borne by bidder; no GST receipt provided. Removal within 5 days of release order, else Rs 500/day rent. Hard disks formatted before handover.

period.completion: Removal within 05 days from date of release order

eligibility: Only authorised producers, refurbishers and recyclers under E-waste Rules 2016, with proof of registration
Undertaking to store/process/dispose e-waste per E-waste Management and Handling rules
Authorised person taking delivery to produce address proof (Aadhaar/election ID)
notes: Mode set to e-auction as closest schema value, but this is an offline sealed-bid auction (not electronic). Date conflict: notice says submission by 24.06.2024 15:00 and document issue 04.06-24.06.2024, while terms clauses 4-6 say inspection/document issue 01.06-19.06.2024 and submission by 20.06.2024 15:00. Website written as 'www.dgll@nic.in'/'www.dgll@gov.in'.
